dialogues.speaker: Raunak
dialogues.text: You two have a fascinating fashion sense. We haven't seen a customer wearing a Sumeru Rose for quite some time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on, lemme think... "Sumeru Rose" means... common merch.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, look again. We're obviously wearing Mourning Flowers.

dialogues.speaker: Raunak
dialogues.text: Ah, my mistake. I do apologize.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... That pop quiz sure was scary!

dialogues.speaker: Raunak
dialogues.text: The warehouse is up ahead. Please follow me.
